title: File:Kryvyi Rih 2014 - 01.jpg
desc:
OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA

Kryvyi Rih 2014

Europe's largest iron mining city. I was fascinated by the contrast between the red dust, the byproduct of the iron extraction process, and the green of the nature and the people living in the middle, in a city that hasn't changed in decades.
